category_title: Senior primary boys with literacy underachievement and playground behavioral challenges
scenario_title: Collaborative group work and social interactions
minimal_context: The tutor is directing the student to join a group of classmates for an outdoor game in the playground.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time to work with your classmates in groups for our outdoor game.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Do I have to be in a group with him? He is one of those kids that get on your nerves.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to stay with your group and participate in the planned task.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't want to play. I only like it when you can make mistakes and have no one laugh at you.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just go over there and take your turn in the game.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Kicks the game equipment away from the group) I'm not playing with them!
